description: The quality ratchet: each pull request could add one plausible exemption, so these numbers may only fall. scripts/ci/quality_ratchet.py measures them; a nolint directive naming several linters counts under each, so the per-linter counts sum above the number of directives. The ceiling lists name the only functions over cognitive complexity 30 and files over 800 lines, and each value may only shrink.
